_meta.units: MPa (density in g/cm3; also given in t/mm3)

PLA.notes: Bambu PLA Basic, dry, annealed 55 C/8 h like the TDS V3.0 bars. MPa. Axes 1=along bead, 2=across beads in plane, 3=build. E3 and Zt are the TDS Z values (2060, 31). E1, Xt and S12 are back-calculated so that an ISO 527-2 1A bar with 2 walls (0.42+0.45 mm, 17.4% of the gauge width) and a +/-45 core (Bambu Studio defaults) reproduces the TDS X-Y values (2580 MPa, 35 MPa). Stiffness uses CLT; strength uses a plastic rule of mixtures with the core failing by the Hashin matrix criterion. Ratios come from Ferreira 2017 doi:10.1016/j.compositesb.2017.05.013 (E2/E1, G12/E1, +/-45 to 0 deg strength ratio 0.66, Yt/Xt 0.68), Song 2017 doi:10.1016/j.matdes.2017.03.051 (Xc/Xt 1.79, Yc/Yt 2.12) and Gonabadi 2020 doi:10.1007/s00170-020-06138-4 (nu, G13, interlayer shear). S12=19 is for Hashin; use 16 with max-stress. Zc, ν23 and G23 are assumptions. See bead_properties_2026-10-03.md.

wet_knockdown.notes: Multiply the dry values. Bambu store page dry/wet flexural table (https://us.store.bambulab.com/products/paht-cf): modulus X-Y 4230->3640 (0.86), Z 1820->1480 (0.81); strength X-Y 125->115 (0.92), Z 61->49 (0.80); Bambu states a 12-18% decline. Saturated uptake 0.88% at 25 C/55% RH; the page gives no conditioning protocol. Cross-check: Dynamism PA12-CF TDS after 3 days immersed: E_XY 0.92, E_Z 0.84, strength ~1.0. E2, G, Xc, Yt and S factors are assumptions (matrix-dominated).

PAHT-CF.notes: Bambu PAHT-CF (PA12 + other long-chain PA + CF; Tm 225 C), dry, annealed 80 C/12 h like the TDS V3.0 bars (290 C, 100 mm/s, 100% infill). MPa. E3 and Zt are the TDS V3.0 Z values (2180, 47; V2.0 had Zt 64). E1, Xt and S12 are back-calculated so that a 2-wall + +/-45 ISO 1A bar reproduces the TDS X-Y values (3860 +/- 230 MPa, 92 +/- 7 MPa): the coupon model gives 3752 MPa for walls at 17.4% (0.4 mm nozzle) and 4106 MPa at 25% (0.6 mm), and 88 MPa strength. If Bambu's X-Y bars were 0/90, E1 would be about 4640 (the low end of the range). Anisotropy references: Ferreira 2017 PLA-CF E1/E2 = 1.92; BASF Ultrafuse PAHT CF15 flexural XZ/ZX = 2.8; Prusament PA11-CF flexural modulus 6.2 GPa on edge vs 3.0 GPa flat; Belei 2024 doi:10.1089/3dp.2023.0173 PAHT CF15 +/-45 UTS 93.7 vs 0/90 111.3. E2, G12, G13, G23, nu13, nu23, Xc, Yt, Yc, Zc, S13 and S23 are assumptions; see bead_properties_2026-10-03.md.
